transcript.text: Good morning, Ms. Patel, and thank you for convening this review. I want to flag a concern on the hosting element specifically. The draft says 'any journalism student' can host, but in practice, not all journalism students have completed the necessary training to safely and competently operate the camera, microphone, and live-broadcast equipment. I have a specific group of students who have completed our broadcast practicum and the associated hands-on training — only those students are really prepared to host live on air. I think we need to tighten up that language so that hosting is limited to trained, authorized students, both for quality and for privacy reasons, since trained students understand live-broadcast protocols better. I'm happy to share the specifics of which students that covers.
